description: Area home for the InfiniBand fabric. Two independent data paths feed this area: host-side HCA telemetry from every DGX tray (ib_hca_*, live) and the switch / fabric-manager collectors. The Quantum-3 switch collector is live; the UFM, IB-identity and LLDP exporters are stopped, and their panels here read no value until they are restarted. The collector-endpoint reachability panel shows the current producer status.

options.content:
### InfiniBand Fabric — Area Home
[**NVIS Home**](/d/nvis-home) · 14 dashboards · IREN_MKZ GB300 NVL SuperPOD · host HCA telemetry · Quantum-3 switch fleet · UFM / subnet manager · cabling

### Where the InfiniBand data comes from

This area is fed by **two independent paths**, and they are in different states right now.

**1. Host-side HCA telemetry — LIVE.** Every DGX tray publishes its own InfiniBand HCA counters through the node exporter (`ib_hca_*`: port state, transmit wait, packet-sequence errors, link-downed, symbol errors). Nothing on the management network is required for this path. Rail state, port errors, flaps, congestion, signal quality, cabling and blast radius all read it and are current.

**2. Switch and fabric-manager telemetry — SPLIT.** The Quantum-3 switch fleet is polled directly by the switch-firmware collector (`switch_*{kind="ib_switch"}`) and is **live**. The UFM REST controller, the IB identity/link-map sweep and the LLDP collector (`ufm_*`, `ib_switch_*`, `ib_link_*`, `ibl_*`) are **offline** — all seven of their scrape endpoints are down, as the reachability panel below shows. Their dashboards are left fully intact and repopulate the moment those exporters are restarted.

Use the table at the bottom of this page to jump straight to a board and to see which of the two paths it uses.
